info.name: FHKBackend API (Complete 12-Module Collection)
info.description:
Ready-to-use Postman Collection for FintechKids Backend (`FHKBackend`).

- **Pre-configured Bearer JWT (`{{access_token}}`)** at collection level.
- **Auto-updating Variables**: Running `Login`, `Register`, `Refresh`, or any `POST` creation endpoint automatically updates `{{access_token}}`, `{{member_id}}`, `{{task_id}}`, `{{goal_id}}`, `{{reward_id}}`, `{{member_goal_id}}`, and `{{member_reward_id}}`.

item.name: 1. Server Status
item.description: Endpoints to verify that the API service is online and responding properly.

request.description: Verifies that the FastAPI server is online and returns the active environment.

item.name: 2. App Version (Stores)
item.description: Endpoints for mobile clients (`IOS` and `AND`) to check whether a newer or mandatory update exists in the App Store or Google Play.

request.description: Checks if an iOS update or mandatory force_update is available in the App Store.
Checks if an Android update or mandatory force_update is available in Google Play.
Lists the stored version configurations for iOS (`IOS`) and Android (`AND`).
Updates the latest/minimum required store version for `IOS` or `AND`. Requires Bearer JWT.

body.raw:
{
  "latest_version": "1.3.0",
  "min_required_version": "1.0.0",
  "force_update": false,
  "store_url": "https://apps.apple.com/app/id000000000",
  "release_notes": "Performance improvements and new rewards module."
}

item.name: 3. Authentication
item.description: Family registration, login with client-encrypted password, token refresh, and 2-step password recovery with a 6-digit code. Automatically saves `access_token` and `refresh_token` into collection variables.

request.description: Registers a new parent/family account and automatically stores the returned `access_token` and `refresh_token`.
Authenticates with `email_parent` and `password` and automatically saves `access_token` and `refresh_token` to collection & environment variables.
Generates a 6-digit recovery code valid for 15 minutes and auto-saves `debug_recovery_code` into `{{reset_code}}`.
Validates the 6-digit `recovery_code` and updates the parent's encrypted password.
Exchanges a valid `refresh_token` for a new pair of JWT tokens and auto-updates `{{access_token}}`.

item.name: 4. Users / Family
item.description: Retrieve and update the authenticated parent/family profile (`/api/v1/users/me`).

request.description: Returns the profile data of the currently authenticated parent/family.
Updates `name_family`, `approve_pin`, or `password` for the authenticated parent account.

item.name: 5. Family Members
item.description: Create, list, edit, and delete family members linked to the authenticated parent.

request.description: Registers a new family member and automatically saves `identification_uuid` into `{{member_id}}`.
Lists all family members belonging to the authenticated parent.
Partially updates `member_name` and/or `avatar_name` using `{{member_id}}`.
Deletes the family member identified by `{{member_id}}`.

item.name: 6. Family Tasks
item.description: Create, edit (`enable`/`disable`), list all, list enabled, and delete tasks for a family.

request.description: Creates a new family task (status defaults to `enable`) and saves its `id` into `{{task_id}}`.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Clean the bedroom",
  "time_granted": "00:30:00",
  "coins_granted": 50,
  "email_parent": "{{email_parent}}",
  "description": "Make the bed and put away all toys before dinner.",
  "status": "enable"
}

request.description: Updates any field of the task including `status` (`enable` or `disable`).

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Clean bedroom and desk",
  "time_granted": "00:45:00",
  "coins_granted": 75,
  "description": "Make the bed, put away toys, and organize the desk.",
  "status": "enable"
}

request.description: Returns all tasks for the authenticated parent's family regardless of status (`enable` or `disable`).
Returns only tasks with `status = enable` for the authenticated parent's family.
Permanently deletes the task identified by `{{task_id}}`.

item.name: 7. Parent Goals
item.description: Create, list, edit, and delete base goals configured by the parent.

request.description: Creates a new parent goal and saves its `id` into `{{goal_id}}`.
Lists all goals created by the authenticated parent.
Updates `name`, `measure_type`, `value`, or `status` (`active`/`inactive`) of a parent goal.
Deletes the parent goal identified by `{{goal_id}}`.

item.name: 8. Parent Rewards
item.description: Create, list, edit, and delete rewards configured by the parent.

request.description: Creates a new parent reward and saves its `id` into `{{reward_id}}`.
Lists all rewards created by the authenticated parent.
Updates `name`, `time_required`, or `coins_required` for a parent reward.
Deletes the parent reward identified by `{{reward_id}}`.

item.name: 9. Member Goals
item.description: Assign goals to specific family members, track accumulated progress, and delete member goals.

request.description: Assigns a parent goal (`{{goal_id}}`) to a family member (`{{member_id}}`) and saves its `id` into `{{member_goal_id}}`.

query.description: Optional filter by family member UUID

request.description: Lists all member goals for the family (enable `member_id` query param to filter by a single child).
Updates `accumulated_value` or reward settings for a member's goal.
Deletes the member goal identified by `{{member_goal_id}}`.

item.name: 10. Member Rewards
item.description: Register rewards claimed by a family member (`PENDING`), mark them as delivered (`COLLECTED`), and delete claimed rewards.

request.description: Creates a claimed reward record in `PENDING` state and saves its `id` into `{{member_reward_id}}`.

query.description: Optional filter by state (PENDING or COLLECTED)

request.description: Lists all claimed rewards for the family (optional filters: `member_id`, `state`).

item.name: Update Claimed Reward State to COLLECTED

request.description: Parent marks the claimed reward as `COLLECTED` once delivered to the family member.
Deletes the claimed reward identified by `{{member_reward_id}}`.

item.name: 11. Member Balances
item.description: Manage and query the accumulated coins and screen/play time balance for each family member.

request.description: Creates or updates the balance (`coins_obtained` and `time_obtained`) for `{{member_id}}`.
Lists the balances of all members in the authenticated family.

item.name: Get Single Member Balance by UUID

request.description: Retrieves the balance for a specific family member (`{{member_id}}`).
Partially updates `coins_obtained` and/or `time_obtained` for `{{member_id}}`.

item.name: 12. Activity History (Audit Logs)
item.description: Read-only enterprise audit trail showing who performed what action and when across the family account.

query.description: Optional filter by entity type (USER, FAMILY_MEMBER, TASK, GOAL, REWARD, MEMBER_GOAL, MEMBER_REWARD, MEMBER_BALANCE)
Optional filter by action (REGISTER, LOGIN, CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, COLLECT_REWARD)

request.description: Returns the chronological audit log of all actions performed in the family account.
